column3: The files service mints share ids and records each share's owning row and path (file_shares); plugin rows get a row-bound files service, so only the owning row reshares or unshares, and kernel code acts for the owner
column4: XIN-23 #19: any files holder could overwrite or end another row's share by id
column5: k-reach-wide unshareOther and reshareOther are refused and Drive's share survives
